title: OSWorld-Science: A Benchmark of Computer Use Agents for Learning and Using Scientific Software
abstract: arXiv:2609.39903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific software presents a demanding test for computer-using agents based on visual language models (VLMs): completing a research workflow requires interpreting specialized interfaces, manipulating scientific objects, and producing verifiable results. We thus introduce OSWorld-Science, a benchmark and evaluation environment that combines scientifically meaningful tasks, artifact-based evaluation, and an efficient agent harness for studying computer use in the scientific domain. The benchmark contains 12 VLMs and 146 high-quality tasks across several scientific domains and software configurations, covering workflows such as molecular drawing and retrosynthesis, pathology image analysis, statistical computing, and physical simulation. Tasks are developed through expert proposals and iterative human--AI co-design, with selection guided by scientific value and difficulty. Task-specific execution-based evaluators inspect application state

translated_title: OSWorld-Science：一个用于学习和使用科学软件的计算机使用智能体基准
translated_abstract: 科学软件对基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的计算机使用智能体构成了一项严峻考验：完成一个科研工作流程需要解读专业化的界面、操作科学对象并产出可验证的结果。因此，我们推出了OSWorld-Science，这是一个将具有科学意义的任务、基于产物的评估以及高效的智能体框架相结合的基准与评估环境，用于研究科学领域中的计算机使用。该基准包含12个VLM和146个高质量任务，涵盖多个科学领域和软件配置，涉及分子绘制与逆合成、病理图像分析、统计计算和物理仿真等工作流程。任务通过专家提案和迭代式人机协同设计开发，并以科学价值和难度作为筛选指导。针对特定任务的基于执行的评估器会检查应用程序状态
tldr: 该论文提出OSWorld-Science基准，一个包含12个视觉语言模型和146个跨多科学领域高质量任务的评估环境，通过科学意义任务、基于产物的评估和高效智能体框架来检验计算机使用智能体驾驭科学软件的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OSWorld-Science, a benchmark and evaluation environment with 12 VLMs and 146 high-quality tasks across scientific domains that tests computer-use agents on scientific software through scientifically meaningful tasks, artifact-based evaluation, and an efficient agent harness.
